verses.zh: 我儿，要留心我智慧的话语，侧耳听我聪明的言词，
verses.kjv: My son, attend unto my wisdom, and bow thine ear to my understanding:
verses.en: My son, pay attention to my wise words; listen carefully to what I understand.

verses.zh: 为要使你谨守谋略，嘴唇保存知识。
verses.kjv: That thou mayest regard discretion, and that thy lips may keep knowledge.
verses.en: Then you will keep good sense, and your lips will hold on to what you know.

verses.zh: 因为淫妇的嘴滴下蜂蜜；她的口比油更滑，
verses.kjv: For the lips of a strange woman drop as an honeycomb, and her mouth is smoother than oil:
verses.en: The lips of a woman who is not your wife drip honey, and her mouth is smoother than oil,

verses.zh: 至终却苦似茵，快如两刃的刀。
verses.kjv: But her end is bitter as wormwood, sharp as a twoedged sword.
verses.en: but in the end she is bitter as poison and sharp as a two-edged sword.

verses.zh: 她的脚下入死地；她脚步踏住阴间，
verses.kjv: Her feet go down to death; her steps take hold on hell.
verses.en: Her feet go down to death; her steps lead straight to the place of the dead.

verses.zh: 以致她找不着生命平坦的道。她的路变迁不定，自己还不知道。
verses.kjv: Lest thou shouldest ponder the path of life, her ways are moveable, that thou canst not know them.
verses.en: She never thinks about the road to life; her paths wander, and she does not even know it.

verses.zh: 众子啊，现在要听从我；不可离弃我口中的话。
verses.kjv: Hear me now therefore, O ye children, and depart not from the words of my mouth.
verses.en: So now, children, listen to me, and do not turn away from what I say.

verses.zh: 你所行的道要离她远，不可就近她的房门，
verses.kjv: Remove thy way far from her, and come not nigh the door of her house:
verses.en: Keep far away from her; do not even go near the door of her house,

verses.zh: 恐怕将你的尊荣给别人，将你的岁月给残忍的人；
verses.kjv: Lest thou give thine honour unto others, and thy years unto the cruel:
verses.en: or you will give your good name to others and your best years to someone cruel,

verses.zh: 恐怕外人满得你的力量，你劳碌得来的，归入外人的家；
verses.kjv: Lest strangers be filled with thy wealth; and thy labours be in the house of a stranger;
verses.en: and strangers will be filled with what you worked for, and your hard work will end up in someone else's house.

verses.zh: 终久，你皮肉和身体消毁，你就悲叹，
verses.kjv: And thou mourn at the last, when thy flesh and thy body are consumed,
verses.en: At the end you will groan, when your body and your health are worn away,

verses.zh: 说：我怎么恨恶训诲，心中藐视责备，
verses.kjv: And say, How have I hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof;
verses.en: and you will say: how I hated being taught! How my heart pushed away correction!

verses.zh: 也不听从我师傅的话，又不侧耳听那教训我的人？
verses.kjv: And have not obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor inclined mine ear to them that instructed me!
verses.en: I did not listen to my teachers, or pay attention to the people who taught me.

verses.zh: 我在圣会里，几乎落在诸般恶中。
verses.kjv: I was almost in all evil in the midst of the congregation and assembly.
verses.en: I was nearly ruined completely, right in front of everybody.

verses.zh: 你要喝自己池中的水，饮自己井里的活水。
verses.kjv: Drink waters out of thine own cistern, and running waters out of thine own well.
verses.en: Drink water from your own well, running water from your own spring.

verses.zh: 你的泉源岂可涨溢在外？你的河水岂可流在街上？
verses.kjv: Let thy fountains be dispersed abroad, and rivers of waters in the streets.
verses.en: Why should your springs spill out into the street for anyone at all?

verses.zh: 惟独归你一人，不可与外人同用。
verses.kjv: Let them be only thine own, and not strangers’ with thee.
verses.en: Let them be yours alone, and not shared with strangers.

verses.zh: 要使你的泉源蒙福；要喜悦你幼年所娶的妻。
verses.kjv: Let thy fountain be blessed: and rejoice with the wife of thy youth.
verses.en: May your spring be blessed, and may you be happy with the wife you married when you were young.

verses.zh: 她如可爱的麀鹿，可喜的母鹿；愿她的胸怀使你时时知足，她的爱情使你常常恋慕。
verses.kjv: Let her be as the loving hind and pleasant roe; let her breasts satisfy thee at all times; and be thou ravished always with her love.
verses.en: She is like a graceful deer; let her love make you glad and content always.

verses.zh: 我儿，你为何恋慕淫妇？为何抱外女的胸怀？
verses.kjv: And why wilt thou, my son, be ravished with a strange woman, and embrace the bosom of a stranger?
verses.en: My son, why would you go after a woman who is not your wife?

verses.zh: 因为，人所行的道都在耶和华眼前；他也修平人一切的路。
verses.kjv: For the ways of man are before the eyes of the LORD, and he pondereth all his goings.
verses.en: Everything a person does is right in front of the LORD's eyes; he sees all their paths.

verses.zh: 恶人必被自己的罪孽捉住；他必被自己的罪恶如绳索缠绕。
verses.kjv: His own iniquities shall take the wicked himself, and he shall be holden with the cords of his sins.
verses.en: A bad person gets caught by his own wrongdoing; his own sins tie him up like ropes.

verses.zh: 他因不受训诲就必死亡；又因愚昧过甚，必走差了路。
verses.kjv: He shall die without instruction; and in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray.
verses.en: He dies because he would not be taught, and his great foolishness leads him off the road.
